reference.title: Infrastructure Manager — REST Resource: projects.locations.previews.resourceDrifts (ResourceDrift, ResourceDriftTerraformInfo, PropertyDrift)

delivery.note: This is a control-plane REST response, not a push export. A ResourceDrift exists only inside a preview: the preview must be SUCCEEDED or STALE before it can be exported. There is no blob path, partition or compression to document.

notes: The JSON representation of ResourceDrift is published verbatim by Google: name, terraformInfo and propertyDrifts[].
ResourceDriftTerraformInfo publishes address, type, resourceName and provider, all output-only.
PropertyDrift publishes path, beforeSensitivePaths[], before, afterSensitivePaths[] and after; before/after are a Value (arbitrary JSON value), not a fixed scalar type.
The list method returns {resourceDrifts[], nextPageToken, unreachable[]}; the envelope is a separate contract from the item and is not mixed into this schema.
The path is a Terraform state path (e.g. machine_type), not the Compute API field machineType. The two vocabularies must not be normalized into one another.

columns.name: propertyDrifts[].before
columns.type_note: The field table publishes 'value (Value format)' for before/after; no scalar type is fixed.

columns.name: propertyDrifts[].after
columns.type_note: The field table publishes 'value (Value format)' for before/after; no scalar type is fixed.

unverified.name: concrete shape of before/after for a given Terraform type
unverified.reason: The REST reference publishes before/after as a Value (arbitrary JSON). It does not publish a per-resource-type schema, so the simulator may emit only values derived from the estate's own model and must not infer a nested shape from a provider example.

unverified.name: semantics of before/after relative to desired state
unverified.reason: The page describes the values as 'before/after the actions' without stating which side is the desired state for a drift preview. The direction must be measured on a real preview before a consumer maps it to expected/actual.
The envelope belongs to the list method, not to the ResourceDrift item; it is documented at the list method page and is intentionally outside this item schema.

unverified.item: the grammar of propertyDrifts[].path for a map key
unverified.reason: The REST reference publishes `path` as the path of the property drift, but does not publish the path grammar for maps. The simulator emits `labels.<key>` as a scenario path derived from the estate; that spelling is not asserted by the GCP documentation and must not be read as a published contract.
